statement: AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN plan up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure beginning in 2027 and as much as 1 GW by 2030, expanding non-NVIDIA accelerator capacity.
why: Committed gigawatt-scale roadmap capacity on AMD silicon is alternative supply of AI compute that buyers can use when NVIDIA allocation is tight.

impact.mechanism: A staged 250 MW to 1 GW buildout on Instinct parts adds accelerator capacity outside the dominant vendor's queue, easing the effective supply constraint for buyers willing to run ROCm, while pulling datacenter and power capacity behind it.

evidence.excerpt: plan to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure
on the way to as much as 1 GW of AI infrastructure by 2030.

confidence.basis: Primary AMD press release; note the figures are forward plans ("up to", "as much as") rather than contracted volumes.

dispersion: Capacity stated as ceilings ('up to 250 MW', 'as much as 1 GW') with capacity online in H2 2027; no firm order value disclosed.
